description: This file implements a Windows-specific port class for a testing framework, including methods for environment setup, crash handling, and registry modifications.

classes.name: WinPort
classes.description: A class representing the Windows port of the testing framework, handling environment setup, crash reporting, and build checks.

methods.name: determine_full_port_name
methods.description: Determines the full port name based on host platform and OS version.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the WinPort instance, setting up version and crash report handling.

methods.name: additional_driver_flag
methods.description: Returns additional command-line flags for the driver.

methods.name: check_httpd
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP server (Apache) is properly configured.

methods.name: _check_reg
methods.description: Checks or sets registry entries for CGI script execution.

methods.name: setup_test_run
methods.description: Prepares environment and crash service for a test run.

methods.name: clean_up_test_run
methods.description: Cleans up crash service after a test run.

methods.name: setup_environ_for_server
methods.description: Sets environment variables needed for the server.

methods.name: check_build
methods.description: Verifies the build environment and crash service availability.

methods.name: operating_system
methods.description: Returns the operating system name ('win').

methods.name: relative_test_filename
methods.description: Returns a relative path for a test filename.

methods.name: uses_apache
methods.description: Determines if Apache is used for the server.

methods.name: path_to_apache
methods.description: Returns the path to the Apache executable.

methods.name: path_to_apache_config_file
methods.description: Returns the path to the Apache configuration file.

methods.name: _path_to_driver
methods.description: Returns the path to the driver executable.

methods.name: _path_to_crash_service
methods.description: Returns the path to the crash service executable.

methods.name: _path_to_image_diff
methods.description: Returns the path to the image diff executable.

methods.name: _check_crash_service_available
methods.description: Checks if the crash service binary exists.

methods.name: look_for_new_crash_logs
methods.description: Checks for new crash logs since a start time.

methods.name: clobber_old_port_specific_results
methods.description: Removes old crash report results.
